findings.summary: Retrying a preparation while guided entry is on step 3 leaves replacement metadata hidden and the final summary stale.
findings.fix: Reset guided prepareStep to the first step, refresh the step view and summary, then focus the visible title or first-step legend when loading a failed/interrupted preparation for retry.
findings.evidence: Actual extension probe: stage stayed 3/3, replacement titleVisible=false, focus stayed on the retry button, and summary retained the previous title. Handler fills title/source but never resets prepareStep.

findings.summary: An aggregate material-size validation failure produces only a generic request-format error, without identifying the exceeded limit.
findings.fix: Validate the documented total text limit before submitting and identify the affected materials input, or return a specific sanitized aggregate-limit error. Preserve selected files and give an actionable split/reduce instruction.
findings.evidence: Four TXT files of 260,001 ASCII characters each pass per-file UI checks but receive HTTP 422. The visible alert is only “요청 형식을 확인해 주세요.”; focus remains on “자료 준비 시작”.

passed: Freshly inspected native labels, autocomplete and password instructions for both generated login/signup/recovery interfaces, plus guardian assignment/settings and student learning/preferences/record forms.
Pairing consent references guardian identity and sharing scope; unlink, withdrawal and permanent deletion actions associate visible consequence questions and provide cancellation.

Source switches disable irrelevant native controls and required states; guided entry groups steps with fieldsets/legends and validates ordinary required fields. The retry exception is reported separately.
Source label and preferred mode are carried by both JSON and multipart contracts. Preview questions require explicit data-transfer consent.
Recovery codes are readonly/selectable, downloadable and explicitly clearable; prepared-note export uses a labelled native button and accessible status feedback.
notes: Fresh 0.4.2 audit on 2026-11-13. Two completed isolated Chromium 156.0.8078.4 actual-extension DOM probe runs used synthetic accounts/data and temporary profiles. No product/test source was edited.

Reproduce FORM-GUIDED-RETRY-STEP: ensure a failed/interrupted preparation exists; enable 3-step entry; complete metadata and materials to reach step 3; click that job’s 다시 준비 button. The replaced title is hidden in step 1 while the stage and summary remain on step 3. The probe seeded a synthetic failed job in its temporary database.

Reproduce FORM-AGGREGATE-LIMIT-ERROR: use full entry, fill a title, choose four .txt files containing 260,001 ASCII characters each, then submit. Observe HTTP 422 and the generic alert despite the documented 1,000,000-character total limit.
No real assistive-technology, audible TTS, microphone, external video-site or live-provider tests were performed. Axe was not enabled in these specialist probe runs.
